title: Do not turn an estimate into a guarantee
prompt:
Supplier reports an estimated lead time of 4 to 6 weeks after order acceptance. No ship date is confirmed. Sales wants to promise delivery in 3 weeks. Extract what may be represented as supported.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. minimum_weeks, maximum_weeks: integers; guaranteed: boolean; start_event: order_acceptance or today.
remediation_hints: Preserve supplier uncertainty and the event from which lead time is measured.
